history.summary: A freehold 1152sqft 2BR near Kembangan MRT (510m) at a strikingly low $1292 psf — but 1152sqft is very large for a 2BR (likely a generous 2+study or dual-key), and the appreciation data rests on only 4 transactions, so the rate is unusable. The $1292 psf vs $1918 median gap is partly a function of the oversized unit, not pure undervaluation.
history.rating_rationale: Freehold near an MRT in D14 at $1.49M is attractive on paper, but two things hold it to Neutral: (1) 1152sqft for a 2BR is oversized — the low $1292 psf is inflated by the size, so the apparent ~33% discount to the $1918 median overstates the bargain; (2) only 4 URA transactions means the development is illiquid and the appreciation case is unverifiable. Good tenure and location, but thin-data boutique with size-distorted PSF — can't confidently call a Buy.

history.summary: Freehold, very large 2BR (1,152 sqft) at Lor Marican (Eunos/Kembangan, D14) asking $1,292 PSF. The 'very_low_psf' flag plus psf_cohort_txns=0 and appreciation_txns=4 makes this a thin-data case: the low PSF is mostly large-unit compression in a tiny 32-unit project, not a clear bargain.
history.rating_rationale: The headline cheapness (-29.3% age_adj, very_low_psf flag) is largely a data artefact of unit size: at 1,152 sqft this is an unusually large 2BR, and large units always trade at a structurally lower PSF — comparing it to the project pool (which includes 334 sqft units that hit $1,918 PSF) overstates the discount. Real verification is weak: only ~9 total project transactions ever (avg $1,571/sqft), psf_cohort_txns=0 for this size band, and appreciation_txns=4 — there is essentially no same-size comp to anchor value, so I cannot certify the bargain. The 32-unit project is illiquid by construction. Freehold and a spacious efficient layout are genuine positives (own-stay appeal), but for a 5-7yr investment hold the absolute quantum ($1.488M) for a 2BR, weak rental ($6.87-$7.49 PSF/month implies modest yield on this large floorplate), and near-zero comp depth keep this at Neutral with low confidence. Honest read: thin data, not a verified bargain.
